evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 rising monotonically during growth: 5.6 → 11.4 → 18.3 → 24.4 → 29.7 ppm, versus ~2-5 ppm baseline during ramp
Tube pressure creeping up 3.03 → 3.275 Torr at constant Ar flow (100 sccm), suggesting ingress of air
Ar flow steady at setpoint, so pressure/O2 rise is not flow-driven

args.missing_evidence: Whether O2 and pressure continue to climb; a leak-check (stop Ar flow and watch pressure rise rate, or raise Ar flow and see if O2 dilutes) would distinguish a seal leak from an exhaust restriction or O2 sensor drift.
